messages.content:
Analyze the following resume text and extract structured information.
Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting.

Resume:
"""
Karthik Reddy
Hyderabad | karthik.reddy@example.com

SUMMARY
Android engineer with five years of experience building high-traffic consumer apps.

SKILLS
Kotlin, Java, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Flow, Dagger Hilt, Room, Retrofit, Firebase, Gradle, Espresso

EXPERIENCE
Senior Android Engineer, PhonePe (2021 - Present)
Migrated the home screen from XML views to Jetpack Compose, cutting frame drops by 30%.
Reduced cold start time from 2.8s to 1.3s with baseline profiles and lazy module loading.
Owned the offline-first sync layer built on Room and WorkManager.

Android Developer, Dunzo (2019 - 2021)
Built the live order tracking screen using Google Maps SDK and WebSockets.
Set up crash monitoring with Firebase Crashlytics and brought the crash-free rate to 99.7%.

PROJECTS
BudgetBuddy: an expense tracker on the Play Store with 100k downloads.

EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Science, JNTU Hyderabad, 2019

"""

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "skills": ["skill1", "skill2", ...],
  "experience_summary": "A 2-3 sentence summary of their work experience",
  "projects": ["Project 1: brief description", ...],
  "education": "Degree, University, Year"
}

Rules:
- skills: extract ALL technical and soft skills mentioned
- experience_summary: summarize roles, companies, and years of experience
- projects: list each project with a one-line description
- education: most recent degree with institution
- If a section is not found, use empty string or empty array
